The Stratagus is an open-source game engine for real-time strategy games. It was originally released by Lutz Sammer as a Warcraft II clone for Linux, named ALE Clone but later renamed to FreeCraft in 1999. Blizzard Entertainment in 2003 sent a cease and desist letter due to the name possibily causing confusion with StarCraft and Warcraft, and some things in the engine were to similar to that of Warcraft II. The project was renamed to Stratagus in 2004 with the focus of turning the game engine into a configurable RTS engine.

Sturgy Ironband was Tormus Deepforge's mentor. He taught blacksmithing in eastern Dun Morogh. One of his students brought him a new ore to work with that he named, Umbral Ore. The Dark Iron dwarves attacked the compound and killed everyone. His strongbox that hold the ore that caused his death is now guarded by the Dark Iron dwarf Captain Beld. Adventurers of the Alliance sent by Tormus avenged his death and retrieved the Umbral ore. His home can be found in southeastern Dun Morogh.

Strongarm Airstrip was an Alliance airfield in Jade Forest, overseen by Captain Doren in his campaign against General Nazgrim and the Horde. The Stunned, Angry Shark is a bait item that can be fished up from the Great Sea surrounding the Broken Isles and from Black Barracuda Schools, with an increased chance to be caught when using an Arcane Lure. It can also be bought from Impus for . This item remains in the angler's bags for one minute. If it is not used before that time has elapsed, it will disappear. When used, it spawns a dangerous Landlocked Shark, which will drop Seabottom Squid when killed. If this item is used after one has obtained the Underlight Angler, the shark will instead drop Seabottom Squid.
